attachments.origin_landmark: iliac crest (anterior two-thirds, intermediate line), thoracolumbar fascia, lateral inguinal ligament
attachments.insertion_landmark: costal cartilages 10-12 and linea alba via the aponeurosis; lowest fibers form the conjoint tendon with transversus abdominis

actions: laterally flexes and ipsilaterally rotates trunk (unilateral)
lowest fibers (with cremaster) support the inguinal canal

functional_compartments.name: Main part
functional_compartments.function_note: Fibers fan superomedially, roughly perpendicular to external oblique's overlying fibers -- the classic teaching contrast in fiber direction between the two oblique layers.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

functional_compartments.name: Inferior part (conjoint-tendon fibers)
functional_compartments.function_note: Lowest, most transversely-oriented fibers, innervated by L1 rather than the thoracoabdominal nerves proper -- documented separately because they blend with transversus abdominis to form the conjoint (inguinal falx) tendon reinforcing the inguinal canal's posterior wall.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
